# ex: implicit address-of cancels inner * (ex.go:610-614)
# Pattern wildcard is pointer *T, source expression is (*ptr) which is T.
# When substituting, &(*ptr) simplifies to ptr.
ex {
	var p *T
	p.M() -> Use(p)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ v int }

func (t *T) M() int { return t.v }

func Use(t *T) int { return t.v }

func f() {
	var ptr *T
	_ = (*ptr).M()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@

 func f() {
 	var ptr *T
-	_ = (*ptr).M()
+	_ = Use(ptr)
 }
